prompt: Vidéo : 'FluentCRM vs MailPoet — lequel choisir en 2025 ?'. assertions.name: has_diagnostic_table
assertions.description: Section I contains a markdown table rating each concept CTR /10

assertions.name: has_3_concept_optimizations
assertions.description: Section II contains detailed optimization for exactly 3 concepts

assertions.name: has_all_7_subfields

assertions.name: has_final_recommendation

assertions.name: has_title_combo

assertions.name: has_strategic_angle
